purpose: Focused synthetic verification of FC08-F1 terminal-finalization ownership and FC08-F2/F3 invocation revision and attempt binding.

target_identity.test_usage: identity contract only; production job was not opened or modified

runs.case: FC08-F1 process crash after public publication and sidecar, before terminal reconciliation
runs.expected: child stops after durable publication; job remains nonterminal; same synthetic identity resumes; public report, sidecar, result, report HTML, deployment and all eight stage handoffs/observations are read back; sole reconciliation finalizer completes job while incident remains in_progress
runs.actual: PASS; 1 passed, exit 0. Crash and resume use the same temporary SQLite job identity. Reconciliation verifies all eight stage records and outputs plus local bare-remote HTML readback before exactly one finalizer call. Final job is complete and incident remains in_progress.
runs.cleanup: pytest basetemp retained under .pytest-tmp-fc08-f1-success-final-r2 for evidence; no persistent or production data changed

runs.case: FC08-F1 missing stage handoff cannot finalize complete
runs.expected: missing required handoff prevents complete finalization and does not resolve incident
runs.actual: PASS; 1 passed, exit 0. Missing evidence is recorded as incomplete and the fixture does not become complete.

runs.case: FC08-F1 missing public report readback cannot finalize complete
runs.expected: public remote readback missing content prevents complete finalization
runs.actual: PASS; 1 passed, exit 0. The fixture deletes the published file from a clone of the temporary bare remote; reconciliation observes the absent public report and leaves job incomplete.

runs.case: FC08-F1 report-publication retry matrix regression after finalization ownership moved to reconciler
runs.expected: all six local-remote identity/target/push/sidecar retry parameters preserve publication evidence without finalizing job or incident in the publication stage
runs.actual: PASS; 6 passed, exit 0. Publication returns without finalizer calls; fixture job remains running until reconciliation.
runs.initial_failure: The first run on the changed product returned six FAIL because the existing test asserted controller.finalized was empty and then indexed controller.finalized[-1]. The test had a stale assertion from the old publication-finalizer contract. Only that contradictory assertion block was removed; the exact node was rerun and passed 6/6.
runs.cleanup: temporary repositories/remotes and pytest basetemp retained for evidence; no shared/public remote was used

runs.case: FC08-F2 source fingerprint changes when a maintenance source changes in isolated copy
runs.expected: copy source tree, change one copied maintenance source, and observe different invocation fingerprint without editing repository product files

runs.case: FC08-F2 a single captured revision is shared by invocation failure event and stage handoffs
runs.expected: inject stage error; event and all eight handoffs preserve same immutable invocation revision and correlation; later stage runners execute

runs.case: FC08-F2 capture failure is unknown, correlated, concrete, and does not block later stages
runs.expected: capture error records unknown revision, concrete reason, exception cause and safe failed source ref; later runners and handoffs continue

runs.case: FC08-F3 sequence-3 deployment candidate/recovery attempt and sequence-4 report attempt stay correctly associated
runs.expected: validated sequence-3 maintenance_repair attempt or null is used by deployment; report event/handoff uses actual maintenance_report sequence-4 attempt, never decoy
runs.actual: PASS; each independently run node passed 1 case, exit 0
runs.initial_failure: The first valid-repair fixture failed because the test read attempt_id from handoff.identity; schema stores attempt_id at handoff top level. Test-only assertion was corrected and the focused node passed.

initial_fixture_failures_retained: F1 earlier JUnit files fc08-f1-crash-resume-r2 through r7 preserve setup iterations: JobStartResult.job_id field mismatch; repair predecessor pin requirement; report schema status mismatch; child publication failure from fixture schema; Git text conversion made hash assertion invalid; handoff root was derived from wrong DB parent. Final fixture corrections are evidenced by the final crash/restart PASS.
F1 missing-public initial JUnit files preserve the untracked-file removal setup failure; final version deletes the file through a clone and push to the temporary bare remote and passes.

F1 publication matrix initial six failures are preserved in fc08-f1-publication-regression-final.junit.xml; the failing assertion contradicted the new stage ownership and was removed as a test-only correction before the final 6/6 run.
F3 first valid-repair assertion failure is preserved in fc08-f3-attempt-binding-valid.junit.xml; corrected test reads the schema top-level attempt_id and final focused node passes.

acceptance.overall_FC07: partial; case-registry retains remaining partial coverage
acceptance.production_same_job_or_publication: not tested here; remains assigned to FC10/FC11
